commands.saneApproach: resolve current truth, choose smallest audit scope, no unnecessary escalation
commands.dryRun: read-only plan and audit receipt; no mutation
commands.update: refresh source/evidence pointers without broadening scope
commands.upgrade: advance one escalation tier only when unresolved evidence justifies it
commands.distro: emit compact doctrine/receipt distribution manifest; not a release
commands.apply: hand bounded mutation packet to authorized executor; never self-execute Crown actions
commands.continue: perform the next safe unresolved step
commands.continueAll: perform all safe non-Crown steps until a stop condition, RED, UNKNOWN, or Crown boundary

forFuckSake.behavior: hard audit of current scope with targeted repairs

scorchedEarth.behavior: deep audit of current scope, aggressive fat pruning and contradictory-state reconciliation

finalForm.behavior: reconcile or replace current structure from evidence after the 50-commit ceiling; never excavate beyond 50 commits by default

goddessRoles.belldandySecretary: state, naming, TTL, snapshots, archive/prune ledger
goddessRoles.yume: art/media only when current scope requires it
